guides.title: 浸潤式微影製程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Immersion lithography processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「用 NA=n sinθ 比較乾式與浸潤式」建立判讀邊界。折射率與入射角共同決定數值孔徑。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare dry and immersion imaging using NA=n sinθ to define the interpretation boundary. Index and ray angle jointly determine numerical aperture. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜用 NA=n sinθ 比較乾式與浸潤式：折射率與入射角共同決定數值孔徑。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜追蹤掃描方向與缺陷條紋：方向性缺陷可提供液體或運動線索。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付光學、液體與量測整合圖：浸潤微影是多子系統協同工程。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare dry and immersion imaging using NA=n sinθ: Index and ray angle jointly determine numerical aperture. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Relate scan direction to defect streaks: Directional defects can reveal fluid or motion effects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver an integrated optics–fluid–metrology diagram: Immersion lithography is a coordinated multisystem process. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「追蹤掃描方向與缺陷條紋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付光學、液體與量測整合圖」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Relate scan direction to defect streaks: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an integrated optics–fluid–metrology diagram to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「浸潤只要把晶圓浸水即可。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「速度提高不會改變液體狀態。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Immersion simply requires submerging a wafer.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Higher speed cannot affect liquid behavior.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 浸潤式微影製程涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用ASML Veldhoven 園區（High-NA 研究代表地）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Immersion lithography processing involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses ASML Veldhoven campus: High-NA reference location as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.
